S.A. Bent, comp.  Familiar Short Sayings of Great Men.  1887.

Alphonse Karr

[A popular French novelist; born at Munich, 1808; published “Sous les Tilleuls,” and other works of fancy, after 1832; editor of “Figaro,” 1837.]
Let the assassins begin! (
Que messieurs les assassins commencent!
)
His answer to the proposal to abolish capital punishment in France.
